briefdescription.para: Ref-counted handle to the active session's VT.
Marks the glyph atlas as stale.

detaileddescription.para: GL thread safe — uses atomic store/release.

briefdescription.para: Consumes and clears the atlas-dirty flag.

detaileddescription.para: GL thread safe — uses atomic exchange/acquire.

briefdescription.para: Returns the resolved renderer type enum.
Resolves and stores the renderer type from a config setting.

detaileddescription.para:
Takes the raw config value ("auto", "true", or "false") and resolves against the stored gpuAvailable flag:
setting != "false" AND gpuAvailable → "gpu"
otherwise → "cpu"

briefdescription.para: Stores the GPU availability flag from a probe result.

detaileddescription.para: Call once at startup before setRendererType(). The probe determines whether the GL pipeline is hardware-accelerated.

briefdescription.para: Stores the UUID for this instance — used by file path methods.

detaileddescription.para: Writes jam::ID::id property on the root VT node. Must be called in initialise() before load(), save(), or setPort().

parameterdescription.para: The UUID string for this instance.

briefdescription.para: Returns the stored instance UUID.
Stores whether this instance is running as a daemon client.

detaileddescription.para: Call once in initialise() before creating the main window.

briefdescription.para: Returns true when this instance is running as a daemon client.
Sets the modal overlay type on the TABS node.
Returns the modal overlay type from the TABS node.
Sets the selection mode type on the TABS node.
Returns the selection mode type from the TABS node.
Returns the cwd of the active session, or the user home directory if none.

detaileddescription.para: Reads terminal::id::cwd directly from activeSession — the ref-counted juce::ValueTree handle stored by setPwd(). Reading a live VT reference produces the current value without any binding or listener.

briefdescription.para: Stores a reference to the active session ValueTree.

detaileddescription.para: getPwd() reads terminal::id::cwd from this tree directly. Because juce::ValueTree is ref-counted, the stored handle always reflects current session state — no binding, no listener, no stale reads.

parameterdescription.para: The SESSION subtree of the newly focused pane.

briefdescription.para: Stores the daemon's bound TCP port and writes it to <uuid>.nexus as plain text.

detaileddescription.para: Called by Daemon::start() after binding. Reading this value from the nexus file during the startup scan tells the client which port to probe. Writes ONLY the plain-text port number — no XML, no ValueTree. Daemon calls this. Daemon never touches .display.

briefdescription.para: Returns the stored daemon port, or 0 if none.
Writes the full state (WINDOW + TABS) to nexus/<uuid>.display.

detaileddescription.para: Daemon client mode only. The NEXUS subtree (sessions, loading ops) is excluded — rebuilt live on reconnect. Port and atlasDirty PARAM children are also excluded — transient, not serialized. Daemon never calls this — daemon only writes its port via setPort().

briefdescription.para: Writes the current WINDOW subtree XML to getWindowState().

detaileddescription.para: Cross-instance shared file, independent of session restore state. Called on every quit when lua::Engine::display.window.saveSize is true.

briefdescription.para: Reads getWindowState() and applies PARAM values into the in-memory tree.

detaileddescription.para: Called only for new instances (no prior session state) when lua::Engine::display.window.saveSize is true. Silently no-ops on missing file or parse failure — constructor defaults remain.

briefdescription.para: Reads the full state from nexus/<uuid>.display into the in-memory tree.

detaileddescription.para: Daemon client mode only. Uses replaceState which syncs Parameters via restoreValues(). Falls back silently to constructor defaults if the file is absent or cannot be parsed.

briefdescription.para: Deletes ~/.config/end/nexus/<uuid>.nexus.

detaileddescription.para: Called by daemon on clean exit via AppModel::getContext()->deleteNexusFile(). Link never calls this.

briefdescription.para: Returns ~/.config/end/nexus/<uuid>.display (daemon client mode only).
Returns ~/.config/end/nexus/<uuid>.nexus (daemon's port file).
Returns ~/.config/end/window.state — cross-instance window size file.
Walks AppParameters.xml and populates the ValueTree with PARAM children and Parameter<int> adapters.
